structured.answer: The current account costs me up to 10 ₪ a month on the basic track, maybe 5–10 ₪ under a new rule I didn't fully get. I should keep in it only what might go out right away, definitely not over 15,000 ₪, and move the rest of my 30,000 out, probably to a "קרן כספית יומית".
